definitions.contradiction_detection_rate: Contradiction scenarios returning structured contradiction divided by contradiction expectation count.
definitions.inference_accuracy: Expected inference-rule/evidence checks passed divided by inference expectation count.
definitions.query_accuracy: Expected query statuses matched divided by expected query count.
definitions.scenario_count: Number of canonical G1.1 scenarios executed.
definitions.stale_state_contamination_count: Focused stale-state experiment count where a cycle-1-only relation survived in cycle 2.
definitions.stale_state_contamination_rate: stale_state_contamination_count divided by one focused stale-state experiment.
definitions.unknown_guess_count: Expected UNKNOWN/CONTRADICTORY queries that were incorrectly returned as TRUE/FALSE.
